images.text: LIMITED OFFICIAL USE. of additional individuals other than those named in the classified memorandum should be investigated as part of a full and thorough investigation of the Russian government's efforts to interfere in the 2016 presidential election, including any links and/or coordination between the Russian government and individuals associated with the campaign of President Donald Trump. Confirmation of the authorization to investigate such individuals does not suggest that the Special Counsel has made a determination that any of them has committed a crime. Rather, the Special Counsel has learned information such that further investigation of the pertinent activities of Michael Cohen, Richard Gates, [redacted] Roger Stone, and [redacted] is necessary for the Special Counsel to fulfill his responsibilities under the appointment order. I recommend that you confirm the authority of the Special Counsel to conduct that investigation. II. Individuals who are possibly engaged in jointly undertaken activity pertaining to authorized matters. The Special Counsel has also identified persons or entities who may have been engaged in jointly undertaken activity with individuals the investigation of whom you previously determined to be within the scope of your appointment order. Investigation by the Special Counsel of these additional persons or entities would be consistent with the ordinary course for a United States Attorney's Office or a Department component. In other words, any such office investigating potential criminal activity by one person would include within the same investigation individuals or entities who may have been jointly involved to determine whether they are targets, subjects, or witnesses, or are wholly uninvolved. This practice increases efficiency by avoiding multiple investigations of the same conduct. It also enables the prosecuting office to be aware of the full scope of the conduct to accurately assess the relative culpability of all involved and to identify and obtain the cooperation of co-defendants and witnesses. Assignment at this time of the investigation of persons or entities who may have engaged in jointly undertaken activity to a United States Attorney's Office or Department component would create the possibility that an individual with relevant information about the Special Counsel's investigation might come forward with that information after the Special Counsel concludes his investigation. This occurrence would raise questions about the completeness of the Special Counsel's investigation and the accuracy of his conclusions. Confirmation of the Special Counsel's authority to investigate these matters would not preclude reassignment of such matters to a United States Attorney's Office or Department component at a later time. You previously confirmed the Special Counsel's authority to investigate allegations that Paul Manafort committed a crime or crimes arising out of payments he received from or on behalf of the Ukrainian government before and during the tenure of President Viktor Yanukovych. The Special Counsel has determined that the following individuals or entities may have been jointly involved in that conduct: Richard Gates; [redacted]. I recommend that you confirm the Special Counsel's authority to investigate those individuals and entities in connection with their possible participation in that conduct. 2. LIMITED OFFICIAL USE. DOJ-HSGAC20200728-000064. Cohen. Gates. Stone. Manafort.

images.description: Screenshot of a news article excerpt, with two passages outlined in red boxes and phrases underlined in red, reporting a November 2019 Interfax-Ukraine press conference by Ukrainian MP Andriy Derkach. The article says Derkach claimed the Yanukovych family is suspected of laundering $7.4 billion of criminally obtained income through Franklin Templeton Investments via Ukrainian external government loan bonds, and quotes MP Oleksandr Dubinsky tying the fund to representatives of the U.S. Democratic Party. A highlighted passage carries Derkach’s claims that John Templeton Jr. was a major Obama campaign donor and that Thomas Donilon, Obama’s former national security advisor, is managing director of BlackRock Investment Institute, a Franklin Templeton shareholder. These are the speakers’ claims as reported, not established facts.
images.text: At a press conference at the Interfax-Ukraine agency on Wednesday, MP Andriy Derkach announced that deputies have received new materials from investigative journalists about international corruption and the participation of Ukrainian officials in it. "Last week, November 14, the Prosecutor General’s Office (PGO), unnoticed by the media, announced a new suspicion to the notorious owner of Burisma, ex-Ecology Minister Zlochevsky. According to the suspicion, the Yanukovych family is suspected, in particular, with legalizing (laundering) of criminally obtained income through Franklin Templeton Investments, an investment fund carrying out purchases of external government loan bonds totaling $7.4 billion," Derkach said. With reference to the investigation, he emphasized: it was money criminally obtained by the "family" of Yanukovych and invested in the purchase of Ukrainian debt in 2013-2014. images.description: Mobile screenshot of text from the Electronic Frontier Foundation’s announcement of the death of its founder John Perry Barlow, published February 7 2018. The passage says Barlow passed away quietly in his sleep that morning and credits his vision and leadership for major parts of the Internet, describing his view of the Internet as a fundamental place of freedom. No headline, byline, or site chrome is visible.
images.text: With a broken heart I have to announce that EFF's founder, visionary, and our ongoing inspiration, John Perry Barlow, passed away quietly in his sleep this morning. We will miss Barlow and his wisdom for decades to come, and he will always be an integral part of EFF. It is no exaggeration to say that major parts of the Internet we all know and love today exist and thrive because of Barlow’s vision and leadership. He always saw the Internet as a fundamental place of freedom, where voices long silenced can find an audience and people can connect with others regardless of physical distance.
flags: Source page not visible in the screenshot; text matches the EFF obituary for John Perry Barlow

images.description: Mobile screenshot of a further passage from the Electronic Frontier Foundation’s February 2018 obituary for founder John Perry Barlow. The unnamed author, who says they worked with Barlow at EFF for 27 years, argues Barlow was not naive about technology, and quotes Barlow saying he “predicted Utopia” to give Liberty a running start before what Ed Snowden calls “turn-key totalitarianism.”
images.text: could solve all of humanity's problems without causing any more. As someone who spent the past 27 years working with him at EFF, I can say that nothing could be further from the truth. Barlow knew that new technology could create and empower evil as much as it could create and empower good. He made a conscious decision to focus on the latter: "I knew it’s also true that a good way to invent the future is to predict it. So I predicted Utopia, hoping to give Liberty a running start before the laws of Moore and Metcalfe delivered up what Ed Snowden now correctly calls 'turn-key totalitarianism.'"
flags: Author of the passage is not named in the visible text

images.description: Mobile screenshot of the closing passage of the Electronic Frontier Foundation’s February 2018 obituary for founder John Perry Barlow. It quotes Barlow’s vision of the Internet as a world open to all without privilege or prejudice, and says EFF will continue the work to fulfill his dream.
images.text: Barlow’s lasting legacy is that he devoted his life to making the Internet into “a world that all may enter without privilege or prejudice accorded by race, economic power, military force, or station of birth . . . a world where anyone, anywhere may express his or her beliefs, no matter how singular, without fear of being coerced into silence or conformity.” In the days and weeks to come, we will be talking and writing more about what a extraordinary role Barlow played for the Internet and the world. And as always, we will continue the work to fulfill his dream.

images.description: Screenshot of the official SecureDrop Directory web page (securedrop.org), a project of Freedom of the Press Foundation, with its cube logo, a Donate button, and menu sections (FAQ, News, Directory, Demo, guides). The page text explains SecureDrop as an open-source whistleblower submission system originally coded by Aaron Swartz and advises verifying .onion addresses against the directory. At the bottom, a hand-drawn yellow circle and asterisk annotate the first directory entry, 'Apache' (https://www.apache.be/securedrop), highlighting it without stating why.
images.text: SECUREDROP. A project of FREEDOM OF THE PRESS FOUNDATION. Donate. Main menu. FAQ. News. Directory. Demo. The Official SecureDrop Directory. SecureDrop is an open-source whistleblower submission system that media organizations can install to securely accept documents from anonymous sources. It was originally coded by the late Aaron Swartz and is now managed by Freedom of the Press Foundation. This page contains a list of active instances. Getting started?. Guide for sources. Guide for journalists. Guide for admins. Request help. Sample privacy policy. Instance verification. If you intend to submit information to an organization's SecureDrop, we recommend that you compare the .onion address provided on the organization's Landing Page to the corresponding entry in this list, and verify that the addresses match before continuing. This provides a strong layer of defense against certain types of attacks that might try to trick you into visiting a malicious SecureDrop instance masquerading as a legitimate one. If you encounter a mismatch, please contact us at securedrop@freedom.press (GPG). This could be evidence of an attempted attack, or it could be a simple failure to communicate between an organization running SecureDrop and Freedom of the Press Foundation. In either case, we will investigate the matter and establish a path to resolution. Get involved!. Donate. Apache. https://www.apache.be/securedrop
flags: Yellow annotations circling the 'Apache' directory entry imply unstated significance - annotator's intent unverified

images.description: Screenshot of the plot section of the Wikipedia article 'Jason Bourne (film)' (2016). A reader has annotated it: the fictional social-media company name 'Deep Dream' is highlighted in yellow/orange, and the phrases 'of social media giant Deep Dream' and 'giving the CIA access to Deep Dream' are underlined in red, emphasizing the film's plot point of the CIA seeking real-time mass-surveillance access to a social media platform. Original filename 'deepstatedream.png'.
images.text: Article. Talk. Read. Edit. View history. Search Wikipedia. Jason Bourne (film). From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Edit links. Seeking answers about his past and family, Bourne locates Dassault in Berlin. Decrypting Parsons' files, Bourne discovers that his father, Richard Webb, was a CIA analyst involved in the creation of the Treadstone program. A "malware" program implanted in the files gives the CIA Bourne's location, and Dewey sends a team to capture him, while Lee remotely erases the files. Dassault attacks Bourne, but is killed. Lee alerts Bourne to the team closing in, as she believes that he can be persuaded to return to the agency. Using the few leads he gathered in Berlin, Bourne tracks Malcolm Smith, a former Treadstone surveillance operative, in London and arranges to meet him in Paddington Plaza. Lee persuades Dewey's boss, Edwin Russell, the Director of National Intelligence, to allow her to contact Bourne in person to attempt to bring him back in. Dewey, who opposes her plan, secretly authorizes the Asset to eliminate her team and kill Bourne. Bourne evades Lee and the Asset long enough to confront Smith. Smith admits that Richard Webb created Treadstone, but tried to prevent them from recruiting his son. Under Dewey's orders, the Asset killed Richard Webb in Beirut, making it look like a terrorist attack, in order to persuade Bourne to join Treadstone. Smith is killed by the Asset, while Bourne escapes and finds Lee. She admits that she is not comfortable with Dewey's methods and directs Bourne to a technology convention in Las Vegas. Dewey is scheduled to attend the convention for a public debate on privacy rights with Aaron Kalloor, CEO of social media giant Deep Dream. Kalloor is the public face of corporate social responsibility in the Internet age, but he was secretly funded by Dewey in the startup stage. Dewey intends to use Deep Dream for real-time mass surveillance alongside the latest incarnation of the CIA's targeted assassination 'Beta' program, known as "Iron Hand". When Kalloor has second thoughts about giving the CIA access to Deep Dream, Dewey authorizes the Asset to assassinate Kalloor and Lee. Bourne thwarts the assassinations and confronts Dewey in his suite. Dewey appeals to Bourne's sense of patriotism as he stalls for time. Bourne kills Jeffers, Dewey's right-hand man, and Lee kills Dewey before he can shoot Bourne. Bourne covers up Lee's involvement before chasing the Asset on the Las Vegas Strip and finally killing him during a brutal hand-to-hand fight. In the aftermath, Lee convinces Russell that Dewey's methods were outdated and offers herself as Dewey's replacement as CIA director and Russell's eyes and ears within the CIA. She outlines her plan to use Bourne's trust to bring him back to the agency, but is prepared to kill him if he refuses. Lee meets with Bourne, promising him that the CIA will become the organization he thought it was when he joined. Bourne asks for time to consider her offer and walks away. Lee returns to her car and finds a recording, made by Bourne, of the conversation she had with Russell about bringing Bourne in.
flags: The highlighted/underlined emphasis linking 'Deep Dream' and CIA surveillance access is the annotator's; the article text describes a fictional film plot. All named persons are fictional characters.

images.description: Meme about Beverly Eckert, a 9/11 widow and advocate whose husband Sean Rooney died in the World Trade Center.
